Rohde & Schwarz ESW44 Overview 
The R&S ESW44 is an EMI test receiver with outstanding RF characteristics, including high dynamic range and measurement accuracy. It meets the most stringent requirements for certification measurements in line with CISPR, EN, ANSI-C63.2, MIL-STD-461, DO-160, and FCC. With its FFT-based time domain scan, the R&S ESW44 captures and weights disturbance spectra in virtually no time. The instrument’s real-time spectrum analysis capability with spectrogram function permits a detailed analysis of disturbance signals and their history. MultiView mode delivers a straightforward display of results, even for multiple operating modes. 
Many of our customers seek a compliant EMI test receiver, which have a serious price tag. In most cases, a precompliance EMI analyzer will suffice to troubleshoot detected problem areas or running a scan to get an overview of your products performance to its desired limits.
